title: Create an empty dog dictionary
description:
Create an empty dictionary called dog.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `create_empty_dog()`, returning a brand new empty dictionary.
hints: A dictionary with nothing inside it is written the same way an empty list is written with square brackets, but using the dictionary bracket character instead.
This function doesn't need any parameters or logic - it just needs to hand back one value: a dictionary that has zero keys in it.
A pair of curly braces with nothing between them, `{}`, is itself a valid empty dictionary literal you can return directly.
expected_behavior: Returns a new, empty dictionary (a dict with zero keys).
explanation: A pair of curly braces with nothing inside, `{}`, is Python's literal for an empty dictionary, exactly like `[]` is for an empty list.
